notes.title: Major content update #1
notes.content:
Hello everyone, you've waited long enough for the first major content update and here it is. This update will add a new playable character alongside with their own unique mechanics, new cards, artifacts, monsters, curse, and a new map with a room system that will allow me more freedom and content for the future.

[h2][b]NEW CHARACTER & NEW MECHANICS[/b][/h2]
Instead of adding more and more cards to the same pool of cards, I've decided to make multiple characters with each their own mechanics and cards. 
This new character is called  [b]THE WARLOCK[/b]
The warlock has 2 new mechanics; 
[list]
[*] Mana
Mana allows you to cast powerful spells and will reset every time you defeat a monster.
[*] Haunt
Haunt is a new type of damage. Instead of directly dealing damage, haunt is delayed by one turn, and if you've used an extra roll this turn, your haunt damage will be [b]DOUBLED![/b]
[/list]

I hope that you'll have fun trying every possible combo with this character and figuring things out.


[h2][b]CHOOSE YOUR OWN PATH[/b][/h2]
This update also contains a new mechanic which will be expanded in the future. From now on, the dungeon will sometimes have multiple choices and rooms with different effects. For now, you only have 3 types of rooms;
[list]
[*]Normal room
[*]Elite room ( Battle an elite monster and get a free artifact if you make it through )
[*]Blind room (You cannot see the HP of the enemy while inside this room)
[/list]
I am working on some new types of rooms and more branching paths for the future to make sure that every run feels unique.


[h2][b]NERFS & BUFFS[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*]Buffed Excalibur artifact.
[*]Buffed Zombie Formula Artifact
[*]Buffed Treant
[*]Buffed Shrunken Head
[*]Nerfed Wicker man
[/list]

[h2][b]Quality of life improvement[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*]Settings are now saved
[*]Multiple bugs and typos fixed.
[*]When reaching max level you will unlock the ability to reroll cards.
[*]The tutorial has been turned off and i am working on a better version of it.
[/list]

[h2][b]Future?...[/b][/h2]
This update took a little bit longer for me to release than I expected, but here it is! If you're curious about what I have planned for the future, I can tell you that I'm working on a new character, new monsters, cards, artifacts, rooms, and [b]a way to go past the last boss[/b]. I really want to make it special and not just another monster with more HP, so if you have ideas, don't hesitate to post them in the Steam forums.

Thanks for your time and reading everything. If you've made it this far, you should check out the credits because there might be something hidden in there. Also, don't hesitate to give me feedback and tell me what you want to see added to the game in the Steam forums.

HAVE FUN !

notes.title: CONTENT UPDATE #1
notes.content:
[h2]Hello everyone this is the first content update on stronghold's dungeon (and definitely not the last) and here's what you can expect in this patch;[/h2]

[b]NEW MONSTERS[/b]
So i've decided to add 3 new monsters to the game, and these monsters come with special abilities to modify the run. Theses monsters are : 
[list]
[*]The loot goblin
[*]The wicker man
[*]And the flying shark
[/list]

[b]NEW ARTIFACTS[/b]
I've added 3 new artifacts to the shop, one of them is a permanent upgrade for all your future runs.

[b]NEW CARDS[/b]
This update contains 4 new cards 3 of them being a part of a new playable build / faction themed around potions! 

[b]NEW CURSE[/b]
I've read and heard your compaints about the lack of content and i've also decided to add a new curse that is harder than all of the previous curses and i will add even more content in the next update. 

[b]BUGS AND TYPOS[/b]

[list]
[*]Game is now playable on all resolutions and aspect ratios.
[*]Added a speed setting to make the game faster.
[*]Fixed a bug you gained rolls on your last roll you would still lose
[*]Fixed a big where unique items would show up in the shop after picking them.
[*]And more minor stuff
[/list]

[b]NERFS & BUFFS[/b]

[list]
[*]Big bad wolf damage reduced from 3 to 2 
[*]Rephrased blacksmith for more clarity
[*]Agility potion is now unique
[*]Adjusted a few HP's and made the game slightly harder
[*]Nerfed magical 7 so it doesnt give you passive gold anymore
[*]Deleted dynamite
[/list]

So this update is slightly smaller than i expected but it's still something, dont hesitate to give me feedback or say what you would like to see in the future. 
GLHF!

notes.title: Small patch ( again )
notes.content:
Alright so i patched a few things up;
[list]
[*]Sometimes the fertilizer didnt upgrade, i think i fixed that for good ( hopefully ) 
[*]Fixed a bug with the furnaces where the damage was incorrect 
[*]Fixed some more typos
[*]Nerfed the Rat from 9 to 8 Dmg
[*]Nerfed the Treant from 3 to 2 poison and from 5 to 4 poison when upgraded
[/list]

More changes, nerfs, buffs, content and clarification to come in the first patch that'll release early December
